assertions: Current pre-execution policy is evaluated again after acceptance; changing the provider decision from allow to deny blocks the operation.
Allow and deny decisions are written to the hash-chained audit store before execution continues or denial is raised.
A required policy provider that is absent fails closed with an unavailable error.
A current require_approval decision blocks without a satisfied approval and allows only after an independent reviewer approves the matching plan, policy fingerprint, and revision.
limitations: This unit campaign exercises in-memory reference providers. It does not qualify external policy, audit, or approval providers or their cross-process consistency.
